load.detail: PostgreSQL 16.15 (Ubuntu 16.15-0ubuntu0.24.04.1), pgvector 0.8.7, 28 MB with indexes; hnsw.ef_search 100, iterative scans relaxed_order

pgvector hnsw-m32-efc200-b0.builder: harness: DROP INDEX, CREATE INDEX ... USING hnsw WITH (m, ef_construction), ANALYZE (wardowl's create_schema takes neither m nor ef_construction)

qdrant as-run-b0.builder: enterprise_rag.QdrantStore.load, as the original run: wardowl's create_collection with keyword indexes on allowed_users, allowed_groups, tenant and wardowl_id, default HNSW (m 16, ef_construct 100) and optimizer, every chunk through QdrantBackend.add

loaded.detail: HNSW cosine, hnsw_ef 128; keyword indexes on tenant and permissions

qdrant is-tenant-b0.builder: as-run, but the tenant index is created with is_tenant=true (harness-level)

qdrant tenant-m0-b0.builder: is-tenant, with hnsw_config m=0 and payload_m=16: one graph per tenant value and no global graph (harness-level)

qdrant separate-kb-b0.builder: company documents and notices in one collection, the FiQA base in another, both created as as-run; each search queries both under the same filter and merges the hits by cosine score (harness-level)

qdrant one-segment-b0.builder: as-run, with optimizers_config default_segment_number=1, max_segment_size 1,000,000 KB and indexing_threshold 0 (indexing off) while the corpus is uploaded into one segment, then indexing_threshold 10,000 KB (Qdrant's default) and a wait until every vector is indexed (harness-level, amendment 2)
